summary: Backend regression + Razorpay billing integration testing for Research Prep AI. 16/16 new billing tests PASSED (100%) covering plan catalog, status, subscription creation with placeholder keys (503), cancel (401/404), webhook (503 with placeholder secret), feature gating on topics/generate (5/day quota → 6th call returns 402 quota_exceeded), and PPT paywall on free tier (402 upgrade_required). Also confirmed the db.usage collection is populated with feature='topic_gens_day' after topic gens. Ran full existing regression suite: 42/42 non-PPT tests still PASS. The previous TestPPT test was updated to expect 402 (paywall) instead of 200, since PPT is now Pro-only — this matches the review request note that 'PPT should now hit paywall gate on free tier - that's expected.' All new billing endpoints degrade gracefully with placeholder Razorpay keys (503 with detail message mentioning 'not configured' / 'Webhook secret not configured'). No React Native/frontend testing performed (backend-only per request).

minor.issue: When webhook secret is placeholder, endpoint returns 503 BEFORE checking the X-Razorpay-Signature header. So requests without the signature header also get 503 (not 400). This is fine for the placeholder-key state, but once real secrets are configured, the current ordering (secret check → dedupe → signature check) is correct. Item flagged only because the review request checklist mentioned 'returns 400 when signature header is missing' — that condition is only reachable AFTER a real RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set. Behavior is by design; no fix needed unless the checklist wording is strict.

Free-tier paper_uploads_month quota is 3. The existing regression test suite (test_backend_api.py) reuses seed user elena@test.com and each full run adds 2 papers (paper_ids fixture + PDF upload test). After this iteration, elena@ is at 3/3 for the month. Any FUTURE regression run this month will fail at the paper_ids fixture with HTTP 402 quota_exceeded. Recommended: bump free-tier paper_uploads_month to something like 20 during dev, OR make the shared paper fixture use a fresh timestamped user, OR reset db.usage before each run.

action_items: Regression side-effect: Increase FEATURE_QUOTAS['paper_uploads_month']['free'] from 3 to ~20 for dev, OR update conftest.py to spin up a fresh timestamped user per session so the shared elena@test.com doesn't exhaust monthly quotas across regression runs.
Consider adding a small admin/reset endpoint (dev-only, gated on env flag) to clear db.usage for a given user_id — makes CI regression cycles idempotent.

Optional hardening: In billing.py webhook handler, when placeholder secret is detected, also acknowledge missing signature header for a clearer 4xx-vs-5xx distinction once real keys land. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: billing.py:_client() raises HTTPException with status 503 correctly when keys contain 'placeholder' — good defensive check. However substring match 'placeholder' would also block any real key that happens to contain the word; acceptable for this environment.

billing.py require_quota(): only 'ppt_unlock' triggers the upgrade_required error branch when limit<=0 AND tier=='free'. If future tiers add other 0-limit features, the branch won't trigger for them — refactor to raise upgrade_required whenever limit <= 0 for ANY feature/tier combo, not only ppt_unlock. Minor.

billing.py webhook: uses razorpay.Client(auth=('k','k')).utility.verify_webhook_signature — creating a client with dummy creds is ugly. razorpay's Utility class can be instantiated directly (razorpay.utility.Utility(client)). Cosmetic.

server.py imports razorpay (via billing.py). If Razorpay ever fails to import, the whole app fails to boot. Consider a lazy import inside _client()/webhook so the app still serves non-billing routes if the razorpay package is missing. Low priority.
billing.py cancel(): 502 leaks raw exception message from razorpay (f'Razorpay error: {e}'). Could contain sensitive info. Wrap with a generic message. Low priority.

billing.py webhook: user_id in notes comes from client-provided data; there's no cross-check that the subscription actually belongs to that user. Since Razorpay owns the notes at creation time (server sets user_id from the current authenticated user), this is safe as long as the create_subscription flow is the only path that sets notes. Note it for future auditing.
server.py delete_project() still doesn't cascade db.usage entries — usage stays after project deletion. Low priority (usage is user-scoped, not project-scoped, so this is likely intentional).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py (updated TestPPT.test_generate_ppt → test_generate_ppt_free_tier_paywalled: now asserts 402 upgrade_required, matching new paywall behavior)

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 new billing tests + 42/42 existing non-PPT + 1/1 updated PPT test = 59/59)

seed_data_creation: Billing tests create a fresh module-scoped user (billing_test_<timestamp>@test.com / pass1234) plus a TEST_Billing Project to isolate quota counters. These test users are not cleaned up (no delete-user endpoint) but are inert. Elena's usage collection now has topic_gens_day and paper_uploads_month entries — see minor issue #2 above.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run new billing tests with: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_billing.py -v -o addopts='' --tb=short`. Runtime ~110s (LLM calls for 5 topic gens dominate). Uses fresh timestamped user per module so quota tests are deterministic. Regression suite in test_backend_api.py now expects 402 on /ppt/generate (paywall). WARNING: elena@test.com's free-tier paper_uploads_month quota may already be exhausted for the current month — either bump the free quota or refactor conftest to use fresh users if you re-run full regression this month. Placeholder Razorpay keys in /app/backend/.env are intentional; endpoints correctly return 503. Once real keys arrive, the webhook signature-invalid (400) and signature-missing (400) branches will need re-testing.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no unresolved defects. Two operational notes: (1) elena@'s paper quota exhausted after this session (3/3 for month); mitigate by seeding a fresh user or bumping free-tier paper_uploads_month during dev. (2) Webhook 400 conditions are unreachable until a real RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is configured; current 503 short-circuit is correct.
